environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward-only, no WAF attached). The /dashboard endpoint serves HTML directly to internal users. CDN scripts are loaded without integrity attributes. No Content-Security-Policy header is configured. The /api/config/update endpoint is accessible to any authenticated internal user via service mesh mTLS.

config.network: ALB with default forwarding rules, no AWS WAF
config.auth: mTLS service mesh (any internal service can call)
